description: This file defines the ClientOutboundConnectionFactory class, which is responsible for creating and configuring outbound client connections within the Orleans runtime messaging framework. It manages initialization of shared services like message center and connection manager, and provides methods to create connections and configure connection builders.

classes.name: ClientOutboundConnectionFactory
classes.description: Sealed class that inherits from ConnectionFactory, responsible for creating outbound client connections, managing initialization of message center and connection manager, and configuring connection building process.

methods.name: ClientOutboundConnectionFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies and settings required for connection creation.

methods.name: CreateConnection
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ClientOutboundConnection for the specified address and connection context.

methods.name: ConfigureConnectionBuilder
methods.description: Configures the connection builder using client connection options.

methods.name: EnsureInitialized
methods.description: Ensures that message center and connection manager are initialized in a thread-safe manner.
